title: Jobs people do
examples: What do doctors do in the hospital?
Can you show me what a farmer does?

explain.say: Today we will learn about different jobs people do.

items: Doctors help people when they are sick.
Teachers help us learn new things.

explain.say: Farmers work on big fields to grow food for us.
Builders use tools to make strong houses and buildings.
A doctor helps you when you get a boo-boo.
Think about when you see a big fire. Who helps everyone?
A real life example is when your school needs a new classroom.

faq.q: What does a teacher do all day?
faq.a: A teacher teaches students many things every day. They help you learn your letters and numbers.
No, firefighters also help people who are stuck or need rescue. They are very brave helpers.

faq.q: Where do farmers grow their food?
faq.a: Farmers grow food on farms, which are large pieces of land. They take care of the plants and animals.
asks: Where do we get our food from?

faq.a: Builders use tools like hammers and saws to build things strong. They make sure the houses are safe for us.
Doctors check how you feel and give medicine when you are sick. They help keep everyone healthy.
asks: When do you see a doctor?

facts: Doctors work in clinics or hospitals.
Farmers grow crops like wheat and corn.
Builders use materials like wood and bricks.

quiz.say: Who helps you learn your ABCs and 123s?
quiz.why: A teacher's job is to educate students in school.

wrong.1: A doctor helps with sickness, not learning.
wrong.2: A farmer grows food in the fields.
wrong.3: A builder makes houses and buildings.

quiz.say: If there is a big fire, who should you call for help?
quiz.why: Firefighters are trained to put out dangerous fires.

wrong.0: A teacher works in a school classroom.
wrong.2: A doctor helps with boo-boos, not fires.
wrong.3: A farmer works with plants on a farm.

quiz.say: Which job involves growing food on land?
quiz.why: Farmers are responsible for growing crops and raising animals.

wrong.1: Builders use tools to make structures.
wrong.2: Doctors work with medicine and health.
wrong.3: Firefighters fight fires and rescue people.
